scope: ZIP archive directory, shape/index/DBF schema header and projection text ONLY
allow: central ZIP directory: exact names/extensions/sizes/compression metadata
SHP and SHX first 100 header bytes (never serialize bounds)
DBF first 32 bytes and field descriptors up to terminator; no rows
PRJ WKT and optional CPG text
schema counts, field names/types, declared CRS and non-sensitive JSON receipt
prohibit: any point geometries, SHP records, DBF record rows, individual IDs, timestamps or coordinates
scoring heldout predictions or modeling tracks
committing any source binary to GitHub
conditions: only one shapefile layer, all mandatory components share basename
DBF count and SHX index count must agree
CRS must be verified from PRJ, not inferred from journal text
result_class: SCHEMA_PASS_ONLY or explicit STOP; never ecological validation
